newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell slightly to 2.6 billion yuan from Tuesday's 2.8 billion with the 60-day contract again the most active.

Traders said some major state bank and short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, traded little today, waiting for the outcome of the on-going national meeting of bankers, traders said.
But some traders said the recent performance of the state debt repurchase and spot contracts indicated that the central bank would maintain its tight monetary policy this year.

"The market rates will stand firm in the short term unless the central bank cuts bank interest rates, as market rumours have suggested they might," a trader said. Officials have declined to comment on the rumours.
